letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai whispers your name, and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad wraps me in thoughts of you. Today, as the calendar flips to a new page, I’m reminded how lucky I am to share this beautiful journey with my cutie. Your laughter is my favorite soundtrack, your smile my guiding star. No matter where we are, my heart beats only for you, forever and always.
poem:
In desert dunes or rainy lanes we roam,  
Your love’s the compass that guides me home.  
With every sunrise, my soul you claim,  
Together we dance, forever the same.
